plan.title: The Last Ship
plan.logline: A lighthouse keeper receives a message from a ship lost at sea and chooses to rescue its last survivor.
plan.ending: The keeper, driven by a desire to protect the last remaining survivor, embarks on a perilous journey to find the ship, navigating through treacherous waters and encountering obstacles along the way. In a climactic confrontation, the keeper must decide whether to risk the lives of the survivor and the ship's crew, or to risk the lives of the other survivors. The outcome is a heart-wrenching sacrifice, as the keeper chooses to save the last survivor at all costs.
